clued_in.title: Clued In
clued_in.text: Do not spend or drop a single clue via treachery cards in Riddles and Rain.

take_that.title: Take That, Ghulat
take_that.text: Ensure that not a single civilian is slain in Dead Heat.

whats_in_a_name.title: What’s in a Name?
whats_in_a_name.text: Tell Amaranth her real name in Dead Heat.

porque.title: Porque No Los Dos?
porque.text: Defeat both copies of Desi simultaneously in Dancing Mad.

lost_and_found.title: Lost and Found
lost_and_found.text: Take control of the Twisted Antiprism without a single clue on Clues Unveiled in Dealings in the Dark.

tower_defense.title: I Like Tower Defense Games
tower_defense.text: Defend The Claret Knight without any Key Locuses being destroyed in Dogs of War v. I.

play_with_food.title: Play With Your Food
play_with_food.text: Steal The Light of Pharos from either The Claret Knight or The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson while they have exactly 1 health remaining in Dogs of War v. II or v. III.

destroyed_chimera.title: More Like “Destroyed” Chimera
destroyed_chimera.text: Defeat all five forms of the Void Chimera in a single session of On Thin Ice.

watch_watcher.title: Who Watches the Watcher?
watch_watcher.text: Unlock a secret final act in Sanguine Shadows.

under_umbrella.title: Under My Umbrella
under_umbrella.text: Do not let Tzu San Niang devour a single Geist enemy in Shades of Suffering.

all_hollow.title: All Hollow
all_hollow.text: Learn about a place where Outsiders dwell and travel there to unlock Without a Trace.

red_looks_good.title: Red Looks Good on Me
red_looks_good.text: Join the Red Coterie in Congress of the Keys.

bloody_red.title: Bloody Red Revolution
bloody_red.text: Overthrow the Red Coterie in Congress of the Keys.

powers_combined.title: With Your Powers Combined…
powers_combined.text: Shift 5 keys in a single turn.

gift_of_gab.title: Gift of Gab
gift_of_gab.text: Ensure that Commissioner Taylor orders you to “talk” 3 times during a single campaign.

cuisine.title: “I’m Just Here for the Local Cuisine”
cuisine.text: In a single campaign, sample cuisine and/or visit bars or cafes from the following locations: Marrakesh, Havana, Buenos Aires, Tokyo, and Kuala Lumpur.

speed_demon.title: Speed Demon
speed_demon.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with only 17 or fewer time passed.

trust_nobody.title: Trust Nobody
trust_nobody.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with 4 [elder_thing] tokens in the chaos bag and without ever removing any [elder_thing] tokens.

trust_everybody.title: Trust Everybody
trust_everybody.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with 4 [tablet] tokens in the chaos bag and without ever removing any [tablet] tokens.

badge.title: Here is Your Badge
badge.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign and earn yourself a permanent position in the Foundation.

heart.title: Key to My Heart
heart.text: Collect each of the following keys throughout The Scarlet Keys campaign:

line_in_sand.title: Line in the Sand
line_in_sand.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

global_expertise.title: Global Expertise
global_expertise.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign on Expert difficulty.

options.reject_offer: Went on your own terms — Deception (remove [tablet], add [elder_thing])
